pr_title: Let users log in with email
pr_summary:
## Why

Users have no way to sign in, so every page is public. This adds email login so accounts can hold their own data.

## What changes

- Add a login form and its POST route
- Store sessions in a signed cookie
- Redirect signed-out users to the form

## Risk

Medium: a session bug locks users out; the route is new, so nothing else changes.
